newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1144 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1144 contracts.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade Project A overnight agricultural contracts trading volume totalled 1144 contracts, compared with 577 contracts traded overnight Wednesday, according to the CBOT.
There were 63 wheat, 486 corn, 566 soybean, 15 soymeal and 11 oat futures contracts traded along with one corn put and two soybean put options.

In overnight trading, wheat was 3/4 to one cent per bushel lower, corn was 3/4 to one cent lower, soybeans 2-3/4 to 4-1/4 cents lower, soymeal $0.40 per ton lower, soyoil 0.03 cent per lb lower and oats three to 5-3/4 cents per bushel lower.
